payload.title: Each language has a glossary kept with the writing guidelines
payload.description:
As an editor, I want a glossary per site and language (approved translation, do-not-translate, note), layered publication then section like the other guideline documents, so names and house terms such as 'desk' are rendered the same way every time.

Design: a new guideline document kind 'glossary' (docs/plans/guidelines-as-data.md), text in S3. Translation jobs receive the entries that occur in the blocks being translated; the fidelity check verifies them. A person's change to a recurring term can be offered as a glossary entry for a person to accept; nothing is learned silently. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).

Feature: Glossary

Scenario: A do-not-translate term stays as written
  Given the Spanish glossary marks a product name as do-not-translate
  When a paragraph with that name is translated
  Then the Spanish text keeps the name unchanged

Scenario: A glossary violation is caught
  Given the Spanish glossary gives an approved translation for a term
  When a translation uses another rendering of that term
  Then the fidelity check reports the term and the approved translation
